visualGate.baselines: human review and approval required before comparisons can pass

completionRule: empty native/http entries, unimplemented or skipped tests, unreviewed baselines, absent required artifacts, failing assertions, and residual human/physical checks do not count as passing acceptance coverage; functional checkpoints or genuine domain handoffs inside audit-failed selectors, discovery-only selection checks, intentionally failed cleanup controls, and blocked journeys excluded from a bounded run do not make the whole selector or criterion pass
